Name: Aeropress
Desc: Simple to use, aasy to clean and travel Friendly, it delviers a clean cup of coffee that gets brewed quickly with minimum efforts with various different recipes to try and experiment. Contains:1 Aeropress Coffee Brewer Set1 Pack Filters (350 filters)

Name: Baarbara Frozen Cherry
Desc: Continuing the tradition having frozen cherry fermented coffees in our collection, this year we have Baarbara estate with their anaerobic frozen cherry processed coffee lot! This coffee is pleasantly rich with notes of dried berries, red wine tannins and finishes off with syrupy honey like mouthfeel. The flavours don't shout unlike other experimental lots, instead this one lingers with a subtle punch.

Name: Gowri Estate
Desc: Gowri estate is a rare gem! Very hard to find, sensitive to roast but a phenominally beautiful coffee! We once had a customer who almost kissed our barista's hands after they had "iced" Gowri estate made on a Chemex!  Yes, it's that good!

Name: Orchardale Estate
Desc: Grown in the beautiful hills of Yercaud, Tamil Nadu, hailing from the prestigious MSP Coffee group of estates, Orchardale estate has been a remarkable discovery for us!  The flavours are a result of mixing two different processing methods, one half is slow fermented & slow dried to impart deep rich flavours while the other half undergoes shorter fermentation and faster drying to impart brightness and crisp mouthfeel.

Name: Stanmore Estate
Tasting_Notes: Good high quality specialty coffee beans from the prestigious Stanmore
Desc: Good high quality specialty coffee beans from the prestigious Stanmore estate. The overall floavour, aroma and taste makes it a great choice for all coffee lovers.
